name: Camp Badakookala
operator_name: Central Connecticut Coast YMCA (Fairfield YMCA branch)
description_short: Camp Badakookala is the Fairfield YMCA's summer day camp for children from kindergarten up, grouped as Greenhorns (K-1st grade), Explorers, Pioneers and Adventurers. Camp runs 9:00 am to 3:00 pm, with before care (7:15 to 9:00 am) and after care (3:00 to 6:00 pm) booked by the week. Financial aid is available and the Y accepts Care4Kids.
refund_policy_summary: Fees are due in full on the Monday two weeks before the session starts. Deposits and registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable. Refund requests must be made in writing on a Refund Request Form. No refunds are given less than 2 weeks before a session starts, except for medical emergencies with a doctor's note. Every refund has a $10 administration fee. No refunds for suspensions or expulsions.
special_needs_notes: Children of all abilities are welcome. Contact the Camp Director ahead of time to talk about your child's needs. An Individual Plan of Care for a Child is required. It is preferred at registration and due no later than two weeks before the session starts.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim instructors are lifeguard certified (this is a general statement for all CCCY camps). Campers bring a labeled towel and swimsuit every day. A Transportation/Swimming Permission Slip is required.
